verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llamafile is a single self-contained executable with no installation, setup or external dependencies, so models can be run immediately after download. That covers the 'lightweight runtime binary' and no-setup parts of the story. Nothing in the pack measures or describes cold-start or time-to-first-inference latency, and the community speed comments are about token throughput, not startup. Missing for 10: documented cold-start or startup-time behavior (e.g., model load latency or memory-mapping of weights), benchmarks or hands-on reports of time-to-first-token, and independent corroboration of fast startup.
